risk_if_not_implemented: Without Lockable Physical Casings, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; man-made threats MT-3, MT-4, MT-5, MT-6, MT-9, MT-10, MT-14.

compensating_control_1.name: Monitoring Physical Access
compensating_control_1.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to monitor for, detect and respond to physical security incidents.
compensating_control_1.justification: Monitoring Physical Access (PES-13) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Lockable Physical Casings (PES-12.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Physical Access Control
compensating_control_2.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to enforce physical access authorizations for all physical access points (including designated entry/exit points) to facilities (excluding those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_2.justification: Physical Access Control (PES-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Lockable Physical Casings (PES-12.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
